title: C03 restore report
description: What a restore established, written by the owner after the live state was replaced from a backup. It names the receipt sequence the backup covers and the instant the backup represents. Work after that instant is neither recovered nor known to be absent: nothing may discard it on the strength of this report. Restored sequencing and control data stay passive until access, clock and keys are established again, so a restored copy cannot unlock or finalize by itself. An incomplete or damaged backup produces no report; its restore is refused with the gap that says so.

covered_through.description: The last receipt sequence the backup holds.

recovery_objective_seconds.description: The configured interval between backups, against which the uncovered window is judged.

after_backup.description: Work after taken_at: one value, because it is neither recovered nor known to be absent.
